concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-008 (Predicted Correctness Column Validation) has no corresponding task. The spec requires a validation step that confirms `predicted_correctness` values are in [0, 1] for every record, but the tasks list only includes T111 (model training) and T112 (runtime/memory logging); a dedicated task (e.g., T122) to generate `predicted_correctness_check.json` is missing.

Success Criterion SC-009 (Ingestion Script Success) is not covered by any task. While T103 downloads data and mentions exit status 0, the spec expects an explicit log artifact `ingest_log.json` with an `exit_code` field. No task creates or validates this log, so the requirement is uncovered.
